Applying the JennAir Promotional Discount in HomeSource

Process Documentation  ·  HomeSource Order Management  ·  Sales Team

What You'll Learn in This Lesson

  • How to identify which line items on an order qualify for a JennAir promotional discount
  • How to calculate the correct discount amount before entering it into the system
  • How to add the JennAir promo MISC item to an existing order in HomeSource
  • How to configure the discount line item (quantity and unit price) so it applies correctly
  • How to save the order once the discount has been added
Section 1

Overview

JennAir periodically offers promotional discounts on qualifying appliances — typically a set percentage off eligible items. When a customer's order includes items covered by an active JennAir promotion, the discount must be manually applied in HomeSource using a MISC item adjustment code.

This process is performed after an order has been created and all qualifying products have been added. The discount is entered as a negative line item, reducing the order total by the calculated promotional amount. It is a brief process, but accuracy in both the calculation and the entry is essential to ensuring the customer receives the correct discount and the order reflects properly.

Section 2

Key Terms

HomeSource
The order management platform used by Fuse to manage customer orders, quotes, invoices, and inventory. All sales transactions are processed here.
MISC Items
A button within an open order that allows users to add miscellaneous line items — including promotional discount codes, adjustment fees, and other non-product entries.
Adjustment Fee
The classification used for promotional discount entries within HomeSource. When you add a promo code, it appears as an Adjustment Fee on the order.
JennAir Promo Code
A system entry (e.g., JENNAIR20OFF or JENNAIR +20 PERCENT BUILDER) that represents the active JennAir manufacturer promotion. The specific code used depends on the promotion currently in effect.
QTY (Quantity)
The quantity field on a line item. For promotional discount codes, this must be set to -1 so the system processes it as a deduction rather than an addition.
Unit Price
The dollar amount field on the discount line item. This is where you enter the total discount amount being applied — calculated as the promotional percentage of all qualifying items.
Section 3

Before You Begin

Before starting this process, take a moment to confirm the following. Completing these steps in advance keeps the process smooth and ensures the discount is applied accurately.

  • Have the customer's order open and ready in HomeSource before adding the promo code
  • Review every line item on the order and identify which products qualify for the current JennAir promotion
  • Calculate the total discount amount (e.g., 20% of all qualifying items) before beginning — you will need this number during the process
  • Confirm the correct promotion percentage and code with your manager or JennAir's current promo guidelines if there is any uncertainty about which code to use
  • Only apply the discount code that matches the promotion currently active — do not apply a higher or lower percentage than authorized
  • Ensure all qualifying products are already on the order before adding the discount; do not add the promo code while the order is still being built
Section 4

Applying the JennAir Promo Discount — Step by Step

Follow these steps in order. This process takes place within an existing order in HomeSource. Make sure you have already calculated your discount amount before starting.

1
Open the Customer's Order & Review Qualifying Items
Open the customer's JennAir order in HomeSource. Go through each line item and identify which products are covered by the current promotion. Calculate 20% (or the applicable percentage) of the total for those eligible items. Write down this number — you will enter it later as the unit price.
💡 Only include items that qualify under the active promotion. When in doubt, check with your manager before proceeding.
2
Click MISC Items
Once you have your discount total calculated, scroll to the bottom of the order. Click the MISC Items button. This opens a panel where you can search for and add adjustment entries, including promotional discount codes.
3
Search for "Jennair" in the Search Bar
In the MISC Items search bar, type Jennair. A list of available JennAir promo codes and adjustment entries will appear. You will see options for different discount percentages.
4
Select the Correct Promo Code
From the results, click on the Jennair +20 Percent Builder (or the code that matches the current active promotion). Available codes include options for 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25% discounts — always select the one that corresponds to the promotion your customer qualifies for.
⚠️ Selecting the wrong percentage code will result in an incorrect discount on the order. Verify the promotion before selecting.
5
Click Done
After selecting the promo code, click Done to add it to the order. The JennAir discount line item will now appear in the order's line items.
6
Locate the Jennair Code Line Item & Click the QTY Field
Scroll through the order to find the newly added JennAir discount line item. Click on the QTY field for that entry. This field currently shows 1 by default and needs to be updated before the discount will apply correctly.
7
Change the QTY to -1
Update the quantity to -1. Setting the quantity to a negative value tells HomeSource to treat this line item as a deduction rather than a charge. This is what causes the discount to reduce the order total.
💡 The QTY must be -1 for the discount to apply properly. A QTY of 1 would add the amount to the order rather than subtract it.
8
Click the Unit Price Field
Click on the Unit Price field for the JennAir discount line item. This is where you will enter the dollar amount of the discount you calculated before starting the process.
9
Enter the Total Discount Amount
Type in the total dollar amount you calculated in Step 1 — this is the amount being discounted off the order. For example, if the qualifying items total $7,697.00 and the promotion is 20% off, you would enter $1,539.40. Because the QTY is set to -1, this amount will be subtracted from the order total.
💡 Always double-check your math before entering the unit price. The number you enter here is what the customer receives as their discount.
10
Click Save Order
Once you've confirmed the QTY is -1 and the Unit Price reflects the correct discount amount, click the Save Order button. HomeSource will process the update and the discount will be reflected in the order total.
Best Practice After saving, review the updated order total to confirm the discount was applied as expected. The JennAir promo line item should display as a negative dollar amount, and the new subtotal should reflect the reduction. If anything looks off, contact your manager before moving forward with the order.
